discovery: Theoretical prediction and experimental discovery of topological insulators (the quantum spin Hall effect)
rationale: The 2024 prize went to machine learning and the 2025 prize to quantum circuits, so the committee is likely to turn back to condensed matter. Topological insulators have the strongest record among the remaining candidates. Kane and Mele predicted the Z2 quantum spin Hall state, and Molenkamp's HgTe quantum-well experiment confirmed it. The idea founded a large field and has won the Breakthrough, Dirac and Buckley prizes. Shoucheng Zhang has died, so the clean three-person attribution is theory (Kane, Mele) plus experiment (Molenkamp).
